spec.description: Overview of all numeric PostgreSQL settings using the settings_num metric. One row per setting per collection, setting name stored as tag. Replaces the legacy wide-column 'settings' metric that caused Prometheus label cardinality explosion.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (data->>'value')::float8 AS value
FROM settings_num
WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
  AND tag_data->>'name' = 'full_page_writes'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (data->>'value')::float8 AS value
FROM settings_num
WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
  AND tag_data->>'name' = 'ssl'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (data->>'value')::float8 AS value
FROM settings_num
WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
  AND tag_data->>'name' = 'data_checksums'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

WITH q_ver_num AS (
  SELECT (data->>'value')::int AS server_version_num
  FROM settings_num
  WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
  AND tag_data->>'name' = 'server_version_num'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
  ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN server_version_num >= 150000 THEN
    ('{pglz,lz4,zstd,on,off}'::text[])[(data->>'value')::int]
  ELSE
    ('{off,on}'::text[])[1 + (data->>'value')::int]
  END AS wal_compression_text
FROM settings_num, q_ver_num
WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
  AND tag_data->>'name' = 'wal_compression'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

  tag_data->>'name'    AS name,
  (data->>'value')::float8 AS value
FROM settings_num
WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
  AND time = (
    SELECT max(time) FROM settings_num
    WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
      AND $__timeFilter(time)
  )
ORDER BY name

spec.description: All numeric settings from the latest snapshot. One row per setting.
spec.title: All Settings (current snapshot)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  tag_data->>'name'                          AS name,
  count(DISTINCT (data->>'value')::float8)   AS distinct_values,
  min((data->>'value')::float8)              AS min_value,
  max((data->>'value')::float8)              AS max_value
FROM settings_num
WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(DISTINCT (data->>'value')::float8) > 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Settings that took more than one distinct numeric value within the selected time window.
spec.title: Settings Changed in Time Range

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time,
  (data->>'value')::float8 AS value
FROM settings_num
WHERE dbname = '$dbname'
  AND tag_data->>'name' = '$setting'
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time
